Public Health & Applied Informatics

## Mars Cruz, MPH, CHES

Public Health Educator · Program Implementation & Evaluation · Community Partnerships

📍 Denver, CO (Remote & Hybrid) ✉️ nalcs.mika@gmail.com

Public health educator and program coordinator with over eight years of experience bridging regulatory compliance, accessible health communication, and cross-functional program operations. I translate complex statutory and clinical requirements (Title VII, Title IX, ADA/WCAG) into plain-language training curricula, pair workforce and program evaluation with SQL, Tableau, and advanced Excel analytics, and build local-first tools that protect sensitive data.

#### Title VII Compliance Analytics & Reporting

Workforce compliance and evaluation initiative at the University of Colorado (22,000+ community members) extracting quantitative teammate records via SQL to audit training adherence, identify outreach gaps across academic and clinical units, and deliver interactive Tableau dashboards for executive leadership.

Data Governance & Plain Language Work Sample

#### Resume Tailor (Local AI Rewriter)

Privacy-first desktop application that compares structured documents against target competency requirements using a local Ollama LLM instance. Models how regulated organizations can adapt complex policy or communications copy into plain-language standards with zero sensitive data transmitted to external cloud APIs.

Key Problem & Architecture:

Offline inference • Plain-language alignment • Zero external data leakage

Data Governance Plain Language Ollama Local LLMs

Clinical Field & Device Controls Work Sample

#### Android Kiosk Lock Task App

Dedicated Android application utilizing enterprise lock-task mode to deploy tamper-resistant, single-purpose kiosk interfaces. Built for community health intake kiosks, outpatient clinical screening tablets, and accessible survey stations where field devices must remain locked to approved workflows.

Application:

Point-of-care field devices • Hardware lockdown • Tamper prevention

Android SDK Java LockTask API Clinical Intake

[View Repository →](https://github.com/TriBrigadeMars/Android-Kiosk-Lock-Task-App)

### Work Experience

#### Prevention, Education, and Outreach (PEO) Coordinator

September 2024 — Present

University of Colorado · Full-Time (40 hr/week) · Denver, CO

- Serve as a technical and regulatory resource for campus leadership and medical providers, translating complex statutory mandates (Title VII, Title IX, ADA) into plain-language educational curricula and accessible digital resources.
- Utilize SQL queries and Tableau dashboards to analyze quantitative employee records and produce recurring Title VII compliance reports for institutional leadership.
- Design and deliver virtual and hybrid compliance seminars for faculty, students, and teammates across an R1 academic and clinical community of over 22,000 members.
- Conduct structured teammate onboarding and civil-rights compliance trainings for cohorts of 150+ attendees.
- Coordinate statewide conferences and cross-functional working groups to align best practices and evidence-based strategies on Title IX compliance.

#### Political Outreach Consultant

July 2024 — September 2024

Valley Forward · Part-Time (24 hr/week)

- Informed and engaged community members on local policy issues; conducted structured perception surveys and field intake.
- Planned field operations and canvassing routes for outreach efficiency leveraging PDI data analytics.
- Collaborated with campaign leadership to track milestones and implement targeted community engagement strategies.

#### Senior Program Coordinator

October 2023 — May 2024

Youth Leadership Institute · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Acted as Project Director for the California Department of Public Health funded program “Mobilizing Youth to Nix Tobacco” (MYNT), managing end-to-end grant compliance, evaluation deliverables, and statutory reporting.
- Authored policy position papers, executive talking points, presentations, and regulatory consultation responses for statewide public health prevention engagement.
- Supported the **$750,000 Sierra San Joaquin Jobs (S2J2) initiative** through cross-sector coalition building with regional stakeholders.
- Partnered across development, communications, and executive lanes to advance public health policy initiatives in Fresno County and the Central Valley.
- Co-facilitated three youth participatory action research electives, engaging 60–70 students per class in research methodology and leadership development.
- Supervised Senior Program Coordinators deploying multi-county health education initiatives across Fresno and Madera Counties.

#### Community Health Worker

March 2023 — October 2023

Centro La Familia Advocacy Services · Full-Time (36.5 hr/week)

- Supported an active client roster of 15–25 individuals, navigating public health benefits, substance use prevention, and housing resources with accessible, plain-language guidance.
- Maintained monthly reporting pipelines including structured case summaries and individualized care plans, tracking progress metrics to inform local resource allocation.

#### Health Education Specialist

January 2022 — February 2023

Merced County Department of Public Health · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Built custom Microsoft Excel visualizations and audit tables using advanced formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH) to track and reconcile open-source Medicaid funding utilization in Merced County.
- Coordinated public health education initiatives for the Local Oral Health Program (LOHP), sustaining operational coalitions between county health leadership and advisory committees.
- Recruited 10–15 key community stakeholders per presentation cycle to drive program adoption and health literacy outreach.

#### Communicable Disease Investigator

October 2020 — December 2021

Fresno County Department of Public Health · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Conducted rapid epidemiological screening interviews and case investigations to trace infection sources across a liaison caseload of 25–60 school districts.
- Translated evolving state and federal clinical isolation and quarantine guidance into actionable protocols for school administrators, faculty, and health professionals during emergency COVID-19 response.

#### Program Coordinator

August 2017 — October 2020

Fresno Barrios Unidos · Full-Time (40 hr/week)

- Administered Apricot CRM system to audit funding streams, foundation deliverables, and longitudinal client service delivery.
- Served as community liaison with City of Fresno councilmembers and municipal staff to advocate for **$500k+ in capital funding** for public wireless networks and bus rapid transit.
- Coordinated youth development and violence prevention cohorts (Men with Heart & Joven Noble), enrolling over 20 youth per cycle.
